question: For each instance VM state, show the average, variance, and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the instance memory (in MB) for instances that have a non-deleted network info cache entry, restricted to instances running on host "blaze8-12". Do not return any rounded answers.

       AVG(i.memory_mb) AS avg_memory_mb,
       VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS variance_memory_mb,
       STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS stddev_memory_mb
FROM instances AS i
WHERE i.host = 'blaze8-12'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM instance_info_caches AS iic
    WHERE iic.instance_uuid = i.uuid
      AND iic.deleted = 0

GROUP BY i.vm_state;
